subject: Taxes
title: Simplification as Nudge
description: A 60-second lesson on Simplification as Nudge.

hook.text: When the UK simplified its tax forms, on-time filing jumped 15%.

buildup.text: Behavioral science shows that complexity is a barrier to action. Even motivated people fail when forms are confusing.

discovery.text: Simplification as Nudge reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Some complexity is intentional. The tax-prep industry profits from confusion.

climax.text: Simplifying the tax form is the cheapest, most effective way to boost compliance.

punchline.text: Fewer boxes, 15% more filings. Simplicity is the strongest nudge.

quiz.question: What happened when the UK simplified its tax forms?
